blocks.title: A troubleshooting story goes here
blocks.body: This page is a labeled placeholder. It becomes real when an actual machine, an actual fault and an actual evidence trail fill it.

blocks.title: Nothing here is a claim
blocks.body: This slot exists to test collections and page patterns. Whatever lands here later must come from work the contributor can stand behind - no invented machines, faults, or fixes.

blocks.heading: What the real page will need
items: The machine and its normal behavior, stated plainly.
The symptom: last normal cycle, first bad cycle.
The evidence trail, one boundary at a time.
The fix, and how it was proven.
What it taught that transfers to the next fault.

items.detail: Expected vs observed, in numbers where possible.

blocks.heading: Bring one real fault
blocks.body: One honest story beats five polished inventions.
